items.title: Durably own late reservation and stopped cleanup

items.title: Define cold recovery for unaccepted local composition preparation

items.title: Reconcile durable outputs with local proof/session lifetimes

items.title: Accept legitimate redispatch aliases without losing input integrity

items.title: Commit ingress replay watermark after durable capture
items.scopeCondition: Non-option admission advances LastSequence before publication; a failure fences exact retry
items.completionCriterion: Retain/serialize pending admission and commit progress after durable ownership; exact retry and successor order survive restart/fan-out

items.title: Resolve option lifecycle snapshot/cleanup retry ownership
items.scopeCondition: Open/close route/cache mutation can suppress failed snapshot send; separate IronCondor final close publications exist
items.completionCriterion: Recover required lifecycle/cleanup or prove allowed display/read-repair semantics; preserve final feed-off/control contract, no route resurrection

items.title: Make legacy market-price failure settlement metrics-independent
items.scopeCondition: IFM.RawFuturesDurableStorage=false and optional metrics absent; default durable raw mode bypasses forward
items.completionCriterion: Required failure is not ACKed in every supported mode, or unqualified legacy configuration is explicitly disabled

items.title: Specify parameter-version compatibility for pending position plans
items.evidenceStatus: reproduced conditional upgrade; not active hot-reload defect
items.scopeCondition: VerticalSpread/pre-intent Futures contexts currently immutable; changed Version during pending replay conflicts
items.completionCriterion: Capture original versioned plan input or explicitly retire incompatible pending work under tested upgrade policy

items.title: Recover latest account convergence and supervise callback reader
items.evidenceStatus: code-confirmed failure paths; outside 25 Realtime destinations
items.scopeCondition: BrokerAccount Event bridge can lose last snapshot, remain faulted, and leave bounded synchronous channel blocking financial callers
items.completionCriterion: Last failed snapshot converges without another callback; startup fault restarts or surfaces readiness; dead reader cannot stall financial progress

items.title: Fence stale same-generation account evidence
items.scopeCondition: Older account AsOf can overwrite newer NewRiskAllowed=false evidence and reopen gate
items.completionCriterion: Monotonic authoritative evidence/order plus equal-time conflict rule; preserve manual/qualification holds

items.title: Realtime backend/options, canonical envelope and durable mailbox registry
items.scopeCondition: ActorType/Name/EntityId is key; all verbs share one consumer. No production backend is registered
items.completionCriterion: Realtime-only Memory/File backend behind current APIs; binary origin envelope, stable registry, cached async lifecycle; other actor categories unchanged

items.title: Confirmed source-to-destination publication and frozen fan-out manifest
items.scopeCondition: Core sends/local enqueue/flush are not durable destination acceptance; raw trade/quote WAL excludes statistics/control families
items.completionCriterion: Every required native/managed/domain/clock source and recipient has original identity plus confirmed capture or recoverable outbox; partial/unknown publishes reconcile

items.title: Broker scheduling, ordered retries, ACKs and independent progress
items.scopeCondition: Current ActorThreadV2 consumes local queues; shared admission/stripes remain; a completion hook alone is not an adapter
items.completionCriterion: Bounded byte/message pulls, one owner/mailbox, no overtaking on fail/ACK uncertainty, idle pull/self-send/cycle safety; migrated Realtime bypasses old shared rejection

items.title: Generation, rollover, consumer eviction and restart lifecycle
items.scopeCondition: Local eviction sees local count only; source fences can settle as success; obsolete and required ownership need explicit policy
items.completionCriterion: Retain pending consumers independent of local objects; fence old execution/ACKs and qualify contract/attachment generation plus wakeup envelope aliases

items.title: Measured finite capacity, overflow ownership, storage guarantees and retention
items.scopeCondition: No complete numeric capacity worksheet; pending journals bounded but sent history unpruned; Memory does not survive broker loss
items.completionCriterion: Per-subject/stream/account/fetch budgets; no TTL/DiscardOld for required work; owned refused publications; safe pruning; tested disk-full and declared Memory/File failure limits

items.title: Broker-aware Actor Health, metrics and readiness
items.scopeCondition: Current local queue counters cannot describe authoritative broker backlog or stalled consumers
items.completionCriterion: Show pending bytes/messages/age, in-flight/ACK/refusal/cursors and source gaps; incident counters survive eviction and health stays truthful

items.title: Actual-owner end-to-end failure/restart and non-Realtime regression
items.evidenceStatus: evidence gate; not an asserted defect
items.scopeCondition: Synthetic terminal receipts do not prove actual workflow/Fund/Portfolio/financial/projector acceptance
items.completionCriterion: Real owners and schemas through before/after commit/ACK, fan-out, source/generation changes, pool disposal and no duplicate financial effects; deadline/proof rules intact

items.title: Matched complete-backend BenchmarkDotNet and burst qualification
items.evidenceStatus: evidence gate; not an asserted defect
items.scopeCondition: Existing component probes exclude parts of real transport, financial owners and NATS RAM
items.completionCriterion: Predeclared capacity/latency gates; local vs Memory vs File under recorded rates/cardinality; p50/p95/p99/max, drain, API+NATS RAM, LOH/Gen2/CPU/IO; two-second decisions separately from queue age

items.title: Two complete matched exchange-session trials per backend
items.evidenceStatus: evidence gate; not an asserted defect
items.scopeCondition: No completed two-session Memory/File qualification exists
items.completionCriterion: Same authoritative captured sessions, overnight/open/close/EOD/rollover; isolated financial effects and complete identity/result reconciliation

items.title: Controlled activation, migration and rollback
items.evidenceStatus: evidence gate; not an asserted defect
items.scopeCondition: Core/local live path remains active; cutover epoch/drain/double-route exclusion unimplemented
items.completionCriterion: Retain pending ownership across both directions; no Core+JS double execution; qualify profile restart/UI/readiness, keep old backend rollback
